Chat request that includes a developer role message alongside user messages

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go/v2"
)

func main() {
	req := pkg.ChatCompletionRequest{
		Model: `gpt-4`,
		Messages: []pkg.Message{
			pkg.Message{Role: `developer`, Developer: &pkg.DeveloperMessage{
				Content: `You are a coding assistant. Always respond with concise code examples.`,
			}},
			pkg.Message{Role: `user`, User: &pkg.UserMessage{
				Content: pkg.UserContent(`"How do I reverse a string in Python?"`),
			}},
		},
	}
	client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	result, err := client.Chat(req)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Choices)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Choices[0].Message.Content)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Choices[0].FinishReason)
}
```
